technique_name: Create a program to categorize animals into different groups.
description: The program would take in different animals as input and then classify them according to the following categories: mammals, reptiles, amphibians, fish, birds, insects, and arachnids. Then it would assign each animal to the correct category and output it to the user. The program should be able to identify different animals easily and provide feedback to the user if they input an animal it doesn't recognize.
